name: noise-background

frames.best_why: Frame 3 spreads the pink and orange blobs widest, showing the full colour range.

tagline: Slow pink, blue and orange blobs drift behind a fine grain wash.
summary: A soft full-bleed panel of drifting colour: violet-pink and warm orange blobs move slowly over deep blue-green, with a fine grain texture and a thin rainbow strip along the top edge.
appearance: A full-bleed, soft-focus wash of colour with deep blue-green at the edges, a violet-pink area through the middle and a warm orange patch toward the right. A fine grain sits over the whole panel and a tiny grey label marks the centre.
behaviour: Three radial colour blobs drift slowly in random directions, easing along and changing course every couple of seconds while staying inside the frame. A thin multicolour strip along the top edge slides in step with them.
demo_content: The label "Noise Background" centred over the gradient.
search_phrases: aurora style background for a section
use_when: A hero or call-to-action panel needs a warm moving colour wash without images or a shader.
avoid_when: The grain is loaded from a remote image, and the drift never pauses for reduced-motion users.
customise: Gradient colours, grain intensity, drift speed, backdrop blur and the animating toggle are props; the layout is set through class names.
weight_why: Three radial gradient layers drift through motion values; no canvas or shader.

a11y.note: The grain image is correctly marked decorative with empty alt, but the endless drift has no prefers-reduced-motion check.

issues: The grain texture is a remote image, so the surface loses its texture if that URL fails.
The demo label is very faint against the moving colour.
polish_why: Soft, well-blended colour and a light grain; the demo label is too faint to read.
